title: DUERER VII (Art therapy knows no age)
summary: This study examines the effects of individual art therapy interventions on the psychological well-being and emotional state of geriatric patients aged 65 and older within the context of geriatric rehabilitation.

interventions.name:
DUERER Intervention Group:
Participants in the intervention group receive, during their 15-day stay in geriatric rehabilitation, two individual art therapy sessions per week (50 minutes each) in addition to standard care.

DUERER Control Group:
Participants in the control group receive standard geriatric rehabilitation care during their 15-day stay and do not receive art therapy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Inpatient treatment in geriatric rehabilitation 

Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS) ≤ 6

Sufficient cognitive abilities to participate in the art therapy intervention, independently complete questionnaires, and manage basic self-care during the sessions (MMSE ≥ 19)

Adequate hearing and vision to follow verbal and visual instructions

Willingness to fully complete all scheduled assessments and questionnaires

Sufficient German language skills (minimum level B1) to participate in the intervention and data collection

Written informed consent for participation in the study
Exclusion criteria:
Age under 65 years

No current inpatient treatment

Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS) ≥ 7

Moderate to severe cognitive impairment (MMSE ≤ 18)

Uncompensated severe hearing loss (> 69 dB) or communication barriers that make interaction impossible without sign language

Lack of willingness to fully complete the scheduled assessments and questionnaires

Insufficient German language proficiency (below level B1) required for participation in the intervention and assessments

Missing written informed consent

Presence of infectious diseases that exclude participation, including suspected cases (e.g., COVID-19) until an infectious status can be ruled out
